title: Toronto to Niagara Wine Tour
includes: Pick up and drop off at Keele Subway Station in Toronto, ON
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
All guests must be 19+ years of age
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: With so many fantastic wineries just outside of Toronto and Hamilton, we would be crazy to let you skip them. This leisurely wine tour will visit three wineries between Hamilton and Grimsby over the course of 6 hours. We pick you up and away we go to enjoy the best wine the GTA has to offer.
